name: camoufox
description: Camoufox stealth Firefox through the Playwright MCP tool contract. Provisions a pinned uv, a managed Python and the engine venv automatically; the pinned Camoufox browser build downloads on first use. Portable profile by default; no CDP.

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Run the browser without a window. Headed mode is measurably less detectable, so leave this off unless you need a server with no display.

tool_profile.title: Tool profile
tool_profile.description: Which tools the Camoufox engine exposes. default follows the engine manifest (portable for camoufox): portable is the shared 24-tool browser core, full is everything this engine supports. The seven tool groups and disabled_tools still apply. Restart Claude Code after changing it.

tools_vision.title: Mouse primitives (vision)
tools_vision.description: Six coordinate mouse tools: click, move, drag, down, up and wheel. Off removes them.

tools_pdf.title: PDF export
tools_pdf.description: browser_pdf_save. This engine cannot produce PDFs (Firefox), so the tool is not exposed; the switch is kept so the same configuration works across engines.

tools_devtools.title: Tracing, video and highlights
tools_devtools.description: Devtools tools: tracing, video, recording, annotations and element highlights. Off removes them.

tools_storage.title: Cookies and web storage
tools_storage.description: Storage tools: cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage and storage state. Off removes them.

tools_network.title: Network routing
tools_network.description: Four network tools: route, unroute, route list and network state. Off removes request interception.

tools_testing.title: Assertions and locator generation
tools_testing.description: Five testing tools: generate_locator and the four verify_* assertions. Off removes them.

tools_config.title: Configuration read
tools_config.description: browser_get_config. Off removes the configuration introspection tool.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to hide from the agent and reject when called, for example browser_start_video,browser_take_screenshot. Leave empty to expose the selected profile unchanged.

profile_isolation.title: Profile isolation
profile_isolation.description: Session safety for the browser profile. shared keeps one profile per account for every Claude Code window, exactly as before. workspace gives each project folder its own profile (profiles/camoufox/ws-<hash>); that profile starts with a fresh login state, and if it is already in use the plugin uses a numbered sibling (ws-<hash>-2 to -5) and reports the switch. isolated uses no browser profile at all: no profile directory is created or locked, cookies, logins and storage are not saved, and nothing persists after the session; Profile directory, Account profile and the default-profile pointer are ignored and reported for that start, and several sessions can run at once. copy runs the session on a temporary copy of the profile that Profile directory, Account profile, the default-profile pointer or the engine default resolves: the base profile is locked for the session and never written, the browser starts on the copy, and the copy is discarded when the session ends cleanly; a crashed session leaves it under profiles/<engine>/.sessions, where browser_profiles list shows it and scripts/profile-copy.mjs --prune removes it. copy-keep does the same and keeps the changes: when the session ends cleanly the base profile is replaced by the session copy and the old base is retained beside it as <name>.previous-<timestamp>; those retained trees are never deleted automatically and accumulate until you remove them. A crash or a hard kill performs no swap: the base stays untouched and the session copy is kept. copy-keep is refused when the base is outside the plugin data directory. copy does not combine with workspace in this version, and neither does copy-keep. In shared, workspace, copy and copy-keep, Profile directory and Account profile win over the mode. Restart Claude Code after changing it.

account.title: Account profile
account.description: Browser profile name for one account. Each name keeps its own cookies, logins and fingerprint seed under Claude Code's plugin data directory (profiles/camoufox/<name>). Leave empty to use this plugin's default profile (profiles/camoufox/default). Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64 characters, no trailing dot or space. Ignored when Persistent profile directory is set. Changing it takes effect when the Claude Code MCP server restarts; sign in to each account manually in the headed window.

profile_dir.title: Persistent profile directory
profile_dir.description: Directory that keeps cookies, logins and the fingerprint seed. It is created if it does not exist. Leave empty to use this plugin's own persistent profile in Claude Code's plugin data directory (profiles/camoufox/default). Use one directory per account.

proxy_server.title: Proxy server
proxy_server.description: Sticky proxy URL, for example http://user:pass@host:port. Leave empty for a direct connection.

proxy_bypass.title: Proxy bypass list
proxy_bypass.description: Comma-separated hosts that should not use the proxy. Leave empty to proxy everything.

output_dir.title: Artifacts directory
output_dir.description: Where Playwright MCP writes screenshots, traces and session files. It is created if it does not exist. Leave empty to write them to .playwright-mcp in the folder the client opened (its first file root), or, when the client advertises no usable file root, to the plugin data folder under output/<engine>.

allow_unrestricted_file_access.title: Unrestricted file access
allow_unrestricted_file_access.description: Remove Playwright's file-access allowlist for tool-chosen paths and unblock file:// navigation, so the model can read and write any file your operating-system user can, not only the Artifacts directory and the client workspace root. A deliberate security trade-off: a prompt-injected page could make the model read or overwrite private files. Leave this off unless you need a path outside those roots.
